name: Swarnim Walavalkar
description:
Swarnim is Backend and AI Lead at Devfolio, building infrastructure and products that connect builders with economic opportunities. 

He led engineering for Synthesis, an agent-native hackathon created with the Ethereum Foundation. 

He built Devfolio’s AI-assisted application review and Agentic Judging systems, using AI to surface evidence, check claims against proof-of-work, and help organizers and judges make better decisions.
